items.title: Charlie Hardy Interview, 1961-12-16
items.q: I think I have heard the Memphis Five, yes.

ctx.x: Uh, you recall, uh, Lada, Anton Lada. No. He came north, and, uh, his band was reasonably popular, uh, especially for recording purposes, apparently, he was a good entertaining band. And, uh, made, corresponded to the Dukes of Dixieland in his day, entertaining, uh, New Orleans, I think. Um, there was a band in the East, I wondered if you'd ever heard, uh, the Memphis Five.
I think I have heard the Memphis Five, yes. Yeah. Either on a record or someplace or someplace.
Yeah, well, they were popular on records, uh, Phil Napoleon, and something like Miss Maul,
